independent_review_protocol: full-source review plus quoted-evidence-audit-v1, required for expanded and full cohorts

expansion.on_completion: Replace active seed with verified expanded cohort; evaluate all selected questions before any outcome-based exclusions.

excluded_questions.question: What is the total price of Sofia Kim's eco-friendly vehicle package, and what adjustment did she want made to it?
excluded_questions.reason: Ambiguous eco-friendly package scope for Sofia Kim across opportunities with different prices; quarantined after full-corpus RAG review.

retained_difficult_questions.reason: SkyTech full-source control passed; RAG truncation is not a dataset quality failure.

artifact_policy: Historical source artifacts remain immutable for audit; retired questions must not be mixed into the new active cohort. HF pilot remains available as a legacy release until replacement publication.
